ticket.title: invocation spans never record task_key, so a task cost cannot be answered from spans alone
ticket.description: Measured 2026-11-10 in the live suite log: 898 spans, zero of them carry task_key, and the fields present are binary, branch, command, duration_ms, repo, span_id, started_at_ms, status, trace_id. Nothing is wrong with the writing path - the field exists on TelemetrySpan and InvocationSpan simply never sets it, so no producer anywhere in the tree populates it. GB-339 acceptance says a task cost is answerable from spans alone, and today it is not: a span says which binary ran in which repository on which branch, and nothing joins it to the ticket whose work it was. The join key exists and is cheap - storypole already knows the active claim at process start, and claim carries the task key - so this is a producer change rather than a schema one. Wanted: InvocationSpan resolves the claimed task key for the current repository at start, records it, and stays absent when no claim is held (absent is honest: an unclaimed run is not attributable). Acceptance: a span emitted while a task is claimed carries its key, a span emitted with no claim carries none, and a query over the log can total duration per task_key.
